why: Private park (now 'Oasis Campground', formerly Al's Oasis Campground) whose cheapest electric RV night is US$65.95 on its own CampWorks booking engine for 2027 shoulder dates (Wed 2027-04-07 and Wed 2027-05-12, site 1 Full Hookup Standard back-in 40 ft, 23-ft motorhome, 2 adults, read 2026-11-22); it is a Good Sam Park, but the engine's Good Sam discount takes only $7.18 off (~$59 before tax, plus a $5.44 online booking fee), still over US$50, and gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest Badlands NP 205 km).
name: Oasis Campground
fees_source: CampWorks engine linked from https://oasiscampsd.com/reservation/ (read 2026-11-22, Motor Home 23 ft, 30 A, 2 adults, 1 night): 04/07/2027 and 05/12/2027 site 1 'Full Hookup Standard' '$65.95 Daily' + city/state/tourism tax + 'Online Booking Fee $5.44'; with 'Good Sam Discount' selected (04/07/2027) '-$7.18', total $69.95; 07/14/2027 site 9 'Full Hook Up Pull Thru' '$80.95 Daily'.
flags: Still operating and selling nights: own site oasiscampsd.com (phone 605-234-6959, online reservations via CampWorks), engine season 04/01-10/31 for 2026 and 2027, no date rules (no minimum stay); engine lists 72-76 sites: 67 full-hookup 30/50 A sites (1-75, back-ins 35-70 ft, pull-throughs 55-70 ft) plus 5 'Dry RV Camping' sites 76-80 in the tenting area. Every electric site is full hookup, so there is no cheaper electric tier.

Camper reports agree: RV Life park 2590 reviews Aug-Oct 2026 paid $60-$84 (several with Good Sam), e.g. Oct 2026 $71 with Good Sam. RoverPass 'Starting Daily $42.95' is an unclaimed page last updated 11/15/2024 - not price evidence.

Good Sam directory cache (trip_data/goodsam_parks.json, fetched 2026-10-02): 'Oasis Campground', Oacoma, gs true, military true. Google Maps 'Oasis Campground' 4.3 from 418 reviews, pin 43.80182,-99.38734, phone +1 605-234-6959, site oasiscampsd.com (read 2026-11-22). RV Life calls it 'Oasis Campground (formerly Al's Oasis Campground)', 4 stars, $$$.
Not in campgrounds.json by name or within ~3 km (nearest: 5726 Dude Ranch LUA 3.5 km, 15756 American Creek 5.3 km), checked 2026-11-22.
Old domain alsoasis.com now 301s to an unrelated site (urh-isag.org) - never cite it.
Other Chamberlain/Oacoma RV place met (not vetted): 'Al's Oasis Truck & RV Parking Lot' (Campendium listing) - appears to be the store's truck/RV parking lot, not a campground.
